logic: Maintain in-memory dict id->book and list all_books ordered by id.
do_DELETE parses path /books/{id}; invalid path or non-integer id returns 404 or 400.
If id exists, remove book from both structures and return 204 with no body.
Unknown query params error on GET only; DELETE has no query params.
